initial.subject: A short note
initial.body: This is a neutral first message. A reply is welcome if you want to continue the conversation.

question.subject: One clarifying question
question.body: Which point would you like to clarify?

objection.subject: Your concern is noted
objection.body: The concern you raised is noted. No outcome is assumed.

followup.subject: The earlier message remains open
followup.body: This is a polite reminder that the earlier message remains open.

handoff.subject: A person can continue this conversation
handoff.body: A person can continue this conversation from here. This message assigns no authority and states no decision.
